previous_statement: The associator axiom and ||U||,||V||,||W||<=2 give ||(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W-U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)||<=8*epsilon_r. The triangle inequality across the five displayed terms yields 84+171+8+171+84=518, hence the asserted bound 520*epsilon_r.
new_statement: Let U,V,W be in calU, put A=mu(U,V) and B=mu(V,W), and suppose ||mu(A,W)-A bold-dot W||<=84*epsilon_r, ||A bold-dot W-(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W||<=171*epsilon_r, ||U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)-U bold-dot B||<=171*epsilon_r, and ||U bold-dot B-mu(U,B)||<=84*epsilon_r. The associator axiom and ||U||,||V||,||W||<=2 give ||(U bold-dot V) bold-dot W-U bold-dot(V bold-dot W)||<=8*epsilon_r. Therefore the triangle inequality along the six-point chain mu(A,W), A bold-dot W, (U bold-dot V) bold-dot W, U bold-dot(V bold-dot W), U bold-dot B, mu(U,B) gives ||mu(mu(U,V),W)-mu(U,mu(V,W))||<=518*epsilon_r<=520*epsilon_r.
